ko.scriptureText: 항상 기뻐하라 쉬지 말고 기도하라 범사에 감사하라 이것이 그리스도 예수 안에서 너희를 향하신 하나님의 뜻이니라
ko.memoryVerseText: 감사함으로 그의 문에 들어가며 찬송함으로 그의 궁정에 들어가서 그에게 감사하며 그의 이름을 송축할지어다
announcements: 오늘은 추수감사절을 준비하는 주일입니다. 감사 제목을 적어 헌금함에 넣어 주세요.
새가족 환영회가 예배 후 친교실에서 있습니다.
겨울 성경공부 등록을 받습니다. 안내 데스크에 신청해 주세요.

en.scriptureText: Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.
hymns: No. 356 Come, Ye Thankful People, Come
No. 28 Now Thank We All Our God
en.memoryVerseText: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.
announcements: Today we prepare for Thanksgiving. Please write a note of thanks and place it in the offering box.
Newcomers' welcome gathering after service in the fellowship hall.
Nov 22 (Sun): Joint Thanksgiving service in three languages.
Winter Bible study sign-up is open at the information desk.
prayer: For the health of our church family
For our missionaries and mission fields
For newcomers to settle in well
worshipOrder: Sermon | Give Thanks in All Circumstances | Senior Pastor

es.scriptureText: Estén siempre alegres, oren sin cesar, den gracias a Dios en toda situación, porque esta es su voluntad para ustedes en Cristo Jesús.
es.memoryVerseText: Entren por sus puertas con acción de gracias; vengan a sus atrios con himnos de alabanza; denle gracias, alaben su nombre.
announcements: Hoy nos preparamos para el Día de Acción de Gracias. Escriba un motivo de gratitud y colóquelo en la caja de ofrendas.
Bienvenida a los nuevos visitantes después del culto en el salón de compañerismo.
Domingo 22 de noviembre: culto unido de Acción de Gracias en tres idiomas.
Inscripción abierta para el estudio bíblico de invierno.
schedule: Dom 11/22 | Culto unido de Acción de Gracias
prayer: Por la salud de nuestra familia de la iglesia
worshipOrder: Sermón | Den gracias en todo | Pastor principal
